comment: Test quarter of island (IslandQuarterTest.cs; sandbox room 5): a fan-shaped quarter, its point standing for the centre of the island (bottom left), its arc for the coast. seed: 0 = a new one each time (R or Select draws again). radius: tiles from the point to the coast; coastNoise / coastScale: how much the coast wavers and the size of its bays; sideNoise: tiles the two straight sides waver; voidMargin: sky around. River: from a spring sourceDistance tiles from the point (a pond of sourceRadius tiles) to the coast, along the middle of the quarter; riverWidth: tiles, at the spring then at the mouth (plus widthNoise); meanderAmplitude / meanderWavelength: tiles; wobble: share of the amplitude left to noise. bridges: how many, spread along the river (bridgeWidth tiles wide). left / right: the sub-biome on each side of the river (left when going downstream), its ROM décors (tilesets) and its colour on the mini-map. road: the main road from the portal to the previous quarter (left side, portalShare of the way from the point) over the middle bridge to the portal to the next one (bottom side): width in tiles, wander (tiles its bends stray), earth décor with stones of stoneDecor (stoneShare of its tiles, in loose groups); broken columns (obstacle 'column') every columnSpacing tiles along it, on both sides with pairChance, columnOffset tiles off its edge. relief: hills and plateaus (hills of hillRadius tiles, a second level on upperChance of the big ones) and a mountain of mountainLevels levels (mountainRadius tiles), kept clearance tiles from the river, the road and the portals; seen in 3/4 view, the side of each level facing the camera (south) is a cliff face faceRows tiles tall per level climbed (darker by faceShade a row towards its foot), the other sides a thin rim (walls drawn with rockDecors[k], C in the sandbox switches k when there are several); stairs (3 columns, rampDecor) cut into the faces are the only way up, plus ledges (one-way: jumping down, ledgeLength columns) on a few faces; the mountain is climbed in zigzags (stairs left, then right) to a cave whose mouth is cut into the last face, a branch of the road leads to its foot. levelShade: tint of each level's ground; footShadow: tint of the first rows below a cliff. cave: the mountain's top level is a cave under a roof (roofDecor's rock, see-through to roofAlpha within fadeTime seconds while the controlled Pokémon is under it): its floor of décor 'decor' tinted 'shade', a few rock pillars, its mouth where the last ramp was (tinted mouthShade). hillStyle / mountainStyle: the cliff_styles.json style drawing the hills' and the mountain's cliffs. props: decor elements of map_props.json scattered on the open ground of each sub-biome (per100: how many per 100 tiles of it, picked at random among the group), clearance tiles away from the road, the river, the cliffs and the portals; a blocking one (tree, rock) blocks its tile and keeps blockSpacing tiles from the others.
